findings.finding: The original prohibits duplicating taxonomy and field sets; replacement explicitly prohibits duplicating only field sets.
findings.fix: Both reference this taxonomy and these field sets without duplicating them.

findings.finding: Original requires fetching comments before classifying an issue as no spec/almost ready/needs prep. Replacement requires it only before reporting, weakening the prerequisite for an internal classification that may drive routing.
findings.fix: Before classifying or reporting "no spec / almost ready / needs prep", fetch comments...

findings.finding: Immediately visible tools do not prove availability reverses the direction of the original warning, which concerns absence from the visible set. Detailed discovery rules remain unchanged, so this is not a new execution-path failure.
findings.fix: Absence from immediately visible tools does not prove unavailability: deferred-tool harnesses such as Codex require discovery.
